market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are an established Premier League club with a squad depth and financial backing that historically keeps them out of serious relegation danger. Even in a worst-case scenario, the true probability of relegation for a mid-table side in a future season is rarely above 20%, well below the market's implied 34.5%. The market appears to be overstating relegation risk this far out.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 14th in 2023-24 (52 pts, +14 above the drop) and were mid-table in 2024-25 as of early 2025, with no current relegation crisis.
Long-term betting markets on established Premier League clubs typically price their relegation odds in the 10-20% range for a single season, not >30%.
The club has stable ownership and revenue, and even with a new manager in 2024-25, they have the resources to invest and avoid the drop.
sources_consulted: 2023-24 Premier League table and historical league finishes
General knowledge of West Ham’s squad valuation and transfer activity
Long-run average relegation frequencies for mid-table Premier League clubs
